info.title: Smart Campus Attendance API
info.description:
Digital ID and Attendance Tracking System — Cavendish University Zambia.

**Authentication:** All protected endpoints require a `Bearer` JWT token obtained from `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.

**RBAC:** Three roles — `Student`, `Lecturer`, `Admin`. The role is embedded in the JWT at login; no extra DB query per request.

get.description: Liveness probe — reports DB connectivity and module status.

post.description: Authenticate a user and return a JWT access token.

get.description: Return the currently authenticated user's full profile.

post.description: Admin: create a new Student account with profile.
Admin: create a new Lecturer account with profile.

get.description: Admin: list all users with pagination.
Admin: get a single user by ID.

patch.description: Admin: update a user's basic fields.

delete.description: Admin: permanently delete a user account.

post.description: Admin: create a new lecture venue.

get.description: Get a single venue by ID.
Get a single course by ID.

post.description: Admin: assign a lecturer to a course.

get.description: Admin: list active lecturer assignments for a course.

delete.description: Admin: deactivate a lecturer's course assignment.

get.description: Admin: browse enrollments across students, courses, and academic periods.

post.description: Admin: enroll a student in a course.

get.description: List all enrollments for a student. Students can only view their own.
Lecturer/Admin: list all enrollments for a course in a given period.

post.description: Admin: issue a new DigitalID card to a student.

get.description: Get the active DigitalID for a student. Students can only view their own.
Admin: list all DigitalIDs (including revoked) for a student.

post.description: Lecturer: open a new attendance session and generate the first QR code.

get.description: List sessions. Lecturers see only their own; Admins see all.
Get a single attendance session by ID.

patch.description: Update mutable fields on an attendance session.

post.description: Lecturer: activate a scheduled session and issue its first live QR code.
Lecturer: close their own session — sets is_active=False.
Lecturer: generate a fresh QR code for an active session. Returns the new QR UUID, expiry, and a base64-encoded PNG image ready to embed directly in an tag.

Student: scan QR code and record attendance.

Validates: active session → enrollment → valid DigitalID → no duplicate.
Sets fraud_flag if GPS accuracy is unavailable.

get.description: Lecturer/Admin: list all attendance records for a session.
List attendance records for a student. Students can only view their own.
Admin: query immutable audit log entries, optionally filtered by user or action.
